svg.title: td / Ownership, process and trust boundaries
svg.desc: Where state lives and who may change it: the td process, the shared core, project-owned state, user-level credentials, review independence, and the separately hosted server. Surfaces stay collapsed so the boundaries around the core, store and sync client are legible; open the full-detail scene for everything.. Colored outlines mark exact authored boundary members, not inferred trust envelopes.
